title.en: Check if an LDAP port is reachable
title.hinglish: Dekho LDAP port reachable hai ya nahi

why.en: Tests TCP 389 on your own domain controller or lab directory (not on machines you don't own).
why.hinglish: Apne khud ke domain controller ya lab directory par TCP 389 test karta hai (aisi machines par nahi jo aapki nahi hain).

expect.en: TcpTestSucceeded True (or 'succeeded') means a directory is listening on 389. If you have no directory of your own, it will fail, which is expected. Output varies.
expect.hinglish: TcpTestSucceeded True (ya 'succeeded') ka matlab hai 389 par directory sun rahi hai. Agar aapki apni directory nahi hai to fail hoga, jo expected hai. Output alag ho sakta hai.

why.en: Active Directory publishes its LDAP servers as DNS SRV records.
why.hinglish: Active Directory apne LDAP servers ko DNS SRV records ki tarah publish karta hai.

expect.en: On a domain network you see DC host names and port 389. For example.com the answer is empty. Results vary by network.
expect.hinglish: Domain network par DC host names aur port 389 dikhte hain. example.com ke liye answer khaali hota hai. Results network ke hisaab se alag hote hain.

title.en: See the bind and search packets

why.en: Open the downloaded .pcap and filter on LDAP messages.
why.hinglish: Download kiya .pcap kholo aur LDAP messages par filter lagao.

expect.en: You see bindRequest, searchRequest, searchResEntry, searchResDone and unbindRequest in order. In the plain scenario the bind password is readable in the packet details.
expect.hinglish: bindRequest, searchRequest, searchResEntry, searchResDone aur unbindRequest order mein dikhte hain. Plain scenario mein bind password packet details mein padha ja sakta hai.

expect.en: Only the bindResponse packets with a wrong-password result remain, as in the wrong-password scenario capture.
expect.hinglish: Sirf woh bindResponse packets bachte hain jinka result galat password wala hai, jaise wrong-password scenario ke capture mein.
